description: Phase A foundation contract — shell, login, design system. Etsy-calm aesthetic: warm off-white, serif headings, spacious layout, one coherent visual language.

no_overflow.description: No horizontal page overflow at 1280px or 1440px viewport width

no_console_errors.description: No unhandled JS errors or React hydration errors in console

shell_present.description: Dashboard and Listings pages show the AppShell: left sidebar with nav items, top bar with user area. All 12 nav routes present (Dashboard, Listings, Content, Users, Orders, Inventory, Reviews, Artisans, Loyalty, Reports, Workflow, Settings).

login_form.description: Login page has email input, password input, and submit button. No shell/sidebar on login page — centered card layout.

etsy_calm.description: Visual language is calm and warm: off-white/warm canvas background (#FAF9F7 range), serif font for headings (Playfair Display), amber/brass accent color, generous whitespace, NOT generic dark-admin.

spacious_layout.description: Content area has ample padding (min 24px). Nav items have sufficient hit area (min 32px height). No cramped text.

nav_active_state.description: Currently active nav item is visually distinguished (warm amber background tint on the active item).

datalist_structure.description: Listings page shows a DataList with: search input, filter button, Add button, table with checkboxes and columns (Product, Category, Type, Price, Stock, Status), pagination area.

loading_not_stuck.description: No page shows Loading... indefinitely. All placeholder pages render immediately.
